sampler: shuffled full-game cycles; hard focus air/golem3x; unique seed for every episode

validation.coverage: 12 games per archetype, 6 per task; deterministic balanced family schedule
validation.eligibility: known terminal outcome for every game; all six families represented
validation.seed_rule: episode_seed=900100+task_index; every physical Match seed distinct across all72 games

initialization: Re-evaluate parent and both corrected-slot candidates on72 distinct validation states; choose by macro/worst score, never by independent test
after_pilots: Select2-4 on both seeds and per-family validation; full train only after budget/quality audit

full_training_gate.rule: If fewer than2 candidates cover all archetypes on both seeds, improve warm-start/curriculum rather than declaring a winner by mean reward
